mapper.select: select * from tb_take_orders where id = #{id} and deleted = 0

SELECT take_order.id, take_order.order_id, address_pick_up.address AS pick_up_address, address_recive.address AS recive_address, orders.order_number, orders.price, orders.real_price, orders.delivery_time, orders.cancel_time, orders.cancel_reson, orders.exceed_time, orders.gap, orders.create_time, orders.door_access, orders.user_id, orders.username, orders.phone, users.realname, orders.status, orders.note, orders.image, orders.category_id, category.image AS category_image, category.category_name, take_order.take_order_create_time, take_order.take_order_image, take_order.take_order_delivery_time, take_order.take_order_cancel_time, take_order.take_order_cancel_reason
FROM tb_orders AS orders,
tb_user AS users,
tb_category AS category,
(SELECT take_order.id, take_order.order_id, take_order.create_time AS take_order_create_time, take_order.image AS take_order_image, take_order.delivery_time AS take_order_delivery_time, take_order.cancel_time AS take_order_cancel_time, take_order.cancel_reason AS take_order_cancel_reason
FROM tb_take_orders AS take_order WHERE take_order.user_id = #{id} AND take_order.deleted = 0 ) AS take_order,
(SELECT ad.id, CONCAT(school.school_name, ' ', compus.compus_name, ' ', build_category.name, ' ', building.building_name, ' ', ad.details) AS address FROM tb_address_book AS ad, tb_school AS school, tb_compus AS compus, tb_build_category AS build_category, tb_building AS building WHERE ad.school_id = school.id AND ad.compus_id = compus.id AND ad.build_category_id = build_category.id AND ad.building_id = building.id AND ad.deleted = 0 ) AS address_pick_up,
(SELECT ad.id, CONCAT(school.school_name, ' ', compus.compus_name, ' ', build_category.name, ' ', building.building_name, ' ', ad.details) AS address FROM tb_address_book AS ad, tb_school AS school, tb_compus AS compus, tb_build_category AS build_category, tb_building AS building WHERE ad.school_id = school.id AND ad.compus_id = compus.id AND ad.build_category_id = build_category.id AND ad.building_id = building.id AND ad.deleted = 0 ) AS address_recive
WHERE orders.pick_up_address = address_pick_up.id AND orders.recive_address = address_recive.id AND orders.id = take_order.order_id AND orders.user_id = users.id AND orders.deleted = 0 AND orders.category_id = category.id ORDER BY take_order.take_order_create_time desc

SELECT take_order.id, take_order.order_id, address_pick_up.address AS pick_up_address, address_recive.address AS recive_address, orders.order_number, orders.price, orders.real_price, orders.delivery_time, orders.cancel_time, orders.cancel_reson, orders.exceed_time, orders.gap, orders.create_time, orders.door_access, orders.user_id, orders.username, orders.phone, users.realname, orders.status, orders.note, orders.image, orders.category_id, category.image AS category_image, category.category_name, take_order.take_order_create_time, take_order.take_order_image, take_order.take_order_delivery_time, take_order.take_order_cancel_time, take_order.take_order_cancel_reason
FROM tb_orders AS orders,
tb_user AS users,
tb_category AS category,
(SELECT take_order.id, take_order.order_id, take_order.create_time AS take_order_create_time, take_order.image AS take_order_image, take_order.delivery_time AS take_order_delivery_time, take_order.cancel_time AS take_order_cancel_time, take_order.cancel_reason AS take_order_cancel_reason
FROM tb_take_orders AS take_order
and id = #{id} and order_id = #{orderId} and user_id = #{userId}
and deleted = #{deleted} and status = #{status}
) AS take_order,
(SELECT ad.id, CONCAT(school.school_name, ' ', compus.compus_name, ' ', build_category.name, ' ', building.building_name, ' ', ad.details) AS address FROM tb_address_book AS ad, tb_school AS school, tb_compus AS compus, tb_build_category AS build_category, tb_building AS building WHERE ad.school_id = school.id AND ad.compus_id = compus.id AND ad.build_category_id = build_category.id AND ad.building_id = building.id AND ad.deleted = 0 ) AS address_pick_up,
(SELECT ad.id, CONCAT(school.school_name, ' ', compus.compus_name, ' ', build_category.name, ' ', building.building_name, ' ', ad.details) AS address FROM tb_address_book AS ad, tb_school AS school, tb_compus AS compus, tb_build_category AS build_category, tb_building AS building WHERE ad.school_id = school.id AND ad.compus_id = compus.id AND ad.build_category_id = build_category.id AND ad.building_id = building.id AND ad.deleted = 0 ) AS address_recive
WHERE orders.pick_up_address = address_pick_up.id AND orders.recive_address = address_recive.id AND orders.id = take_order.order_id AND orders.user_id = users.id AND orders.category_id = category.id ORDER BY take_order.take_order_create_time desc

SELECT user.username, user.realname, user.`phone`, take_order.create_time as take_order_time, take_order.id FROM tb_take_orders AS take_order, tb_user AS user, tb_orders AS orders WHERE take_order.order_id = #{orderId} AND take_order.user_id = user.id AND take_order.order_id = orders.id AND take_order.`deleted` = 0
select * from tb_take_orders where order_id = #{orderId} and deleted = 0
select image from tb_take_orders where deleted = 0 and order_id = #{orderId}
select * from tb_take_orders where order_id = #{orderId} and user_id = #{userId} and deleted = 0

SELECT tk.id, tk.order_id, address_pick_up.address AS pick_up_address, address_recive.address AS recive_address, tb_orders.`order_number`, tb_orders.`price`, tb_orders.`real_price`, tb_orders.`delivery_time`, tb_orders.`cancel_time`, tb_orders.`cancel_reson`, tb_orders.`exceed_time`, tb_orders.`gap`, tb_orders.`create_time`, tb_orders.`door_access`, tb_orders.`user_id`, tb_orders.`username`, tb_orders.`phone`, tb_user.`realname`, tb_orders.`status`, tb_orders.`note`, tb_orders.image, tb_orders.`category_id`, tb_category.`image` AS category_image, tb_category.`category_name` AS category_name, tk.create_time AS take_order_create_time, tk.image AS take_order_image, tk.delivery_time AS take_order_delivery_time, tk.cancel_time AS take_order_cancel_time, tk.cancel_reason AS take_order_cancel_reason
FROM tb_orders, tb_user, tb_category, ( SELECT id, image, create_time, delivery_time, cancel_time, cancel_reason, order_id FROM tb_take_orders WHERE deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} AND STATUS = 2 ) AS tk,
( SELECT ad.id, CONCAT(school.school_name, ' ', compus.compus_name, ' ', build_category.name, ' ', building.building_name, ' ', ad.details) AS address FROM tb_address_book AS ad, tb_school AS school, tb_compus AS compus, tb_build_category AS build_category, tb_building AS building WHERE ad.school_id = school.id AND ad.compus_id = compus.id AND ad.build_category_id = build_category.id AND ad.building_id = building.id AND ad.school_id = #{schoolId} AND ad.deleted = 0 ) AS address_pick_up,
( SELECT ad.id, CONCAT(school.school_name, ' ', compus.compus_name, ' ', build_category.name, ' ', building.building_name, ' ', ad.details) AS address FROM tb_address_book AS ad, tb_school AS school, tb_compus AS compus, tb_build_category AS build_category, tb_building AS building WHERE ad.school_id = school.id AND ad.compus_id = compus.id AND ad.build_category_id = build_category.id AND ad.building_id = building.id AND ad.school_id = #{schoolId} AND ad.deleted = 0 ) AS address_recive
WHERE tb_orders.deleted = 0 AND tb_orders.id = tk.order_id AND tb_orders.status = #{orderStatus} AND tb_orders.`pick_up_address` = address_pick_up.id AND tb_orders.`recive_address` = address_recive.id AND tb_user.id = tb_orders.`user_id` AND tb_orders.`category_id` = tb_category.id AND tb_orders.`price` IS NOT NULL AND tb_orders.`price` != 0

SELECT tk.id, tk.order_id, o.order_number, o.status AS order_status, tk.status AS take_order_status, c.category_name, o.price, o.service_fee, o.pay_amount, o.note AS order_note, ap.address AS pick_up_address, ar.address AS recive_address, pub_user.realname AS publisher_name, o.phone AS publisher_phone, tk_user.realname AS taker_name, tk_user.phone AS taker_phone, tk.create_time AS take_order_time, tk.delivery_time, tk.image AS take_order_image FROM tb_take_orders tk INNER JOIN tb_orders o ON tk.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON o.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN tb_user tk_user ON tk.user_id = tk_user.id LEFT JOIN tb_user pub_user ON o.user_id = pub_user.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ad.id, CONCAT(s.school_name, ' ', cp.compus_name, ' ', bc.name, ' ', b.building_name, ' ', ad.details) AS address FROM tb_address_book ad, tb_school s, tb_compus cp, tb_build_category bc, tb_building b WHERE ad.school_id = s.id AND ad.compus_id = cp.id AND ad.build_category_id = bc.id AND ad.building_id = b.id AND ad.deleted = 0 ) ap ON o.pick_up_address = ap.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ad.id, CONCAT(s.school_name, ' ', cp.compus_name, ' ', bc.name, ' ', b.building_name, ' ', ad.details) AS address FROM tb_address_book ad, tb_school s, tb_compus cp, tb_build_category bc, tb_building b WHERE ad.school_id = s.id AND ad.compus_id = cp.id AND ad.build_category_id = bc.id AND ad.building_id = b.id AND ad.deleted = 0 ) ar ON o.recive_address = ar.id WHERE tk.deleted = 0 ORDER BY tk.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT tk.id, tk.order_id, o.order_number, o.status AS order_status, tk.status AS take_order_status, c.category_name, o.price, o.service_fee, o.pay_amount, o.note AS order_note, ap.address AS pick_up_address, ar.address AS recive_address, pub_user.realname AS publisher_name, o.phone AS publisher_phone, tk_user.realname AS taker_name, tk_user.phone AS taker_phone, tk.create_time AS take_order_time, tk.delivery_time, tk.image AS take_order_image FROM tb_take_orders tk INNER JOIN tb_orders o ON tk.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON o.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN tb_user tk_user ON tk.user_id = tk_user.id LEFT JOIN tb_user pub_user ON o.user_id = pub_user.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ad.id, CONCAT(s.school_name, ' ', cp.compus_name, ' ', bc.name, ' ', b.building_name, ' ', ad.details) AS address FROM tb_address_book ad, tb_school s, tb_compus cp, tb_build_category bc, tb_building b WHERE ad.school_id = s.id AND ad.compus_id = cp.id AND ad.build_category_id = bc.id AND ad.building_id = b.id AND ad.deleted = 0 ) ap ON o.pick_up_address = ap.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ad.id, CONCAT(s.school_name, ' ', cp.compus_name, ' ', bc.name, ' ', b.building_name, ' ', ad.details) AS address FROM tb_address_book ad, tb_school s, tb_compus cp, tb_build_category bc, tb_building b WHERE ad.school_id = s.id AND ad.compus_id = cp.id AND ad.build_category_id = bc.id AND ad.building_id = b.id AND ad.deleted = 0 ) ar ON o.recive_address = ar.id WHERE tk.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (5, 7) ORDER BY tk.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_take_orders WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.price), 0) FROM tb_take_orders tk INNER JOIN tb_orders o ON tk.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (5, 7) WHERE tk.deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.price), 0) FROM tb_take_orders tk INNER JOIN tb_orders o ON tk.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE tk.deleted = 0 AND tk.status = 2 AND tk.delivery_time >= #{startTime} AND tk.delivery_time <= #{endTime}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_take_orders WHERE deleted = 0
